Welcome to NanoBrew Café! Customers come in, sit down and order from your menu. Your job: keep the food coming and turn your happiest customers into Synth staff.
Click a stove and pick a dish to cook. A finished batch goes to the counter.
Your server Synth carries dishes from the counter to the tables. Watch a customer get served and pay.
That customer has a star — they loved it! Click them to spend your NanoBrew: they become a Synth.
Click one of your Synths to see its level and battery and to change its role.
The café is closed: it's night. Plan for tomorrow here, then press End Night.
Open the Menu tab and choose tomorrow's dishes. Customers love their favourites.
Open Night Ops, pick a MegaBean café and a squad, then Plan raid. Raids bring Nano Cores (for NanoBrew) and Influence.
Press End Night to see the night play out.
That's the basics! Take over the Alley by beating its flagship. Good luck.

Coins pay for dishes, upgrades and décor. NanoBrew converts a starred customer. Nano Cores (from raids) brew NanoBrew. Power recharges Synths at night. Suspicion brings MegaBean raids — and at 90, a Corporate Audit. Influence unlocks the district's flagship.

Clerkbot: a fast, steady server, but slows down late in the shift.
Bulkform: strong with a big battery — great raider, but clumsy: sometimes drops dishes.
Glitchling: cooks very fast as a chef, but glitches now and then.
Hypeform: a greeter that brings more customers, but works slowly.
Steady-unit: good at anything and barely uses battery, but slow.
Xeno: a strong chef that unlocks Star Jelly, but needs special fuel (recharging costs 3× Power).
Night Owl: works faster late in the shift instead of slower, +3 power in fights.
Perfectionist: dishes it serves make customers happier (+10), but it works 15% slower.
Chatty: dishes it serves earn bigger tips (+30%) and it greets a little, but works 10% slower.
Kleptomaniac: brings back 30% more raid loot, but may pocket 10 coins at night.

Power is how hard this Synth hits in raids and defending the café. Power = species base × (1 + 8% per level above 1) + trait bonus (Night Owl +3). Each hit deals power × battery (×0.5 below 20%, nothing when empty) × a random 0.8–1.2. Bases: Clerkbot 6, Bulkform 14, Glitchling 8, Hypeform 5, Steady-unit 7, Xeno 10.
